thread:
Alex: ops-bot just fired a cluster-level alert for spot interruptions rate spike in us-west2 and eu-west1. seeing sustained >12% interruption rate over 10m. link: https://grafana.internal/r/d/signal/spot-interruptions
Maya: ack. I'm pulling the dashboard now. is this correlated with any scheduled maintenance?
Raj: not that I can see. gce events api shows a few regional preemptions but not that magnitude. could be capacity exhaustion from customer bursts.
Claire: any SLO hits yet?
Alex: partial — two API routes (generation/high-pri) saw increased tail latency and a few 5xx fallbacks to reserved pool. SLO error budget for generation-route down ~0.8% in last 30m.
ops-bot: ALERT: spot-interruptions-high (rule=spot_node_eviction_rate > 0.10 over 10m)
Maya: hypothesis: mixed pool autoscaler churned too aggressively and removed warm nodes, increasing eviction probability. also noticed preemptible scale-out during peak.
Raj: can we get a quick PromQL snapshot? I ran a query: ```sum by(region)(increase(gce_preemptions_total[10m])) / sum by(region)(increase(gce_instance_count[10m]))``` shows us-west2=0.128, eu-west1=0.115, us-central=0.035
Claire: thx. If signals are noisy we should implement a composite alert that combines eviction rate + instance churn + queued requests to avoid false positives.
Maya: agreed. proposed alert rule (draft): ```alert: SpotAvailabilityDegradation
expr: (sum(increase(gce_preemptions_total[10m])) / sum(increase(gce_instance_count[10m]))) > 0.10 and sum(increase(node_scale_events[10m])) > 5
for: 8m
labels: {severity: "high", team: "eng-infra"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://wiki.redwood/spot-fallback-playbook"}```
Alex: good start. also add an action annotation to trigger auto-fallback to reserved capacity when route error budget < 1% and eviction_rate > 10%.
Raj: proposal for fallback policy tweak: - cooldown on autoscaler down-scaling from preemptible pools to 15m - prefer draining unused spot nodes instead of immediate termination - when composite alert fires, route 20% of traffic for high-priority routes to dedicated until healthy
Claire: cost note: routing to dedicated will increase cost ~25% for that traffic but saves SLO. prefer A/B rollout: 10% for 5m then 20% if still unhealthy.
Maya: I'll patch the alert and add a suppression window to reduce churn. also adding a new panel to show "eviction_rate by instance_age" — older instances tended to be safer.
Alex: ops task list: 1) Maya update Prometheus alert (ETA 30m) 2) Raj change autoscaler cooldown config and add drain policy (ETA 1h) 3) Claire prepare temporary routing runbook + cost ack (ETA 45m) 4) Maya instrument eviction-by-age panel (ETA 45m)
Raj: pinging cloud-sre to confirm no provider maintenance. @cloud-sre can you confirm?
ops-bot: note: linked incident created https://incidents.internal/RED-8345
Maya: quick mitigation applied: increased preemptible pool target to absorb churn and raised downscale cooldown. monitoring for next 20m.
Alex: thanks. can everyone post final post-mortem notes here after stabilization. if interruption rate continues beyond 1h we do the 10%->20% routing plan. :thumbsup:
